subject: MSA + Order Form: counterparty details and redline priorities
messages:
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-analytics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + MSA kickoff / counterparty details

Hi Kimberly and Marissa,

Thanks again — excited to get Redwood set up. Per our conversation this morning, attaching a counterparty worksheet with our billing and legal contacts (ACME_Counterparty_Sheet_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 summary. We anticipate starting pilots in January, so we'd like to move the MSA/order form through review in December if possible.

Key asks from our side:
- Lightning review: can Redwood highlight any non-standard MSA clauses you see up front?
- A single point of contact on Redwood legal for redlines and a rough timeline for initial review (2 weeks would be ideal).
- Confirmation whether Redwood can accept a narrow data processing addendum for the pilot (we may need a short DPA exhibit).

I'll include Marcus from Procurement on follow-ups. Please let me know if you need any additional forms (W9, PO format) — we can produce those.

Attachments: ACME_Counterparty_Sheet_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sophie Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA kickoff / counterparty details

Hi Sophie — thanks for the packet and timeline. I'll own intake on our side and loop Legal for redlines. Quick replies to your asks below:

- Non-standard clauses: we'll do a first-pass extract within 3 business days and flag high-risk items (IP, indemnity caps, data use).
- Legal POC & timeline: Rishi M. (cc'd) will be the primary reviewer. Target initial redline turnaround: 7-10 business days from when we receive the draft MSA + order form. If you can send the counterparty sheet and any preferred redline priorities, that helps triage.
- DPA exhibit: Redwood typically uses a standard exhibit for pilots; if Acme needs a narrow DPA we can evaluate it during redline. Please indicate the exact scope you want covered.

Can you confirm whether Acme will require any special export controls or residency requirements? That will affect the Order Form exhibit.

I'll kick off an internal intake ticket and share the drive link for versioned documents.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-analytics.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA kickoff / counterparty details

Hi Sophie / team — happy to support commercial scheduling. A couple of quick commercial notes:

- Target pilot start in Jan sounds doable. For order form: do you plan to use a PO or direct billing? If PO, please share the PO cadence and invoice contact.
- Pricing: I'll draft a pilot Order Form template and forward it once we confirm billing flow.
- SLA exceptions: if you need different latency or uptime SLAs for the pilot, note those now so Legal can flag any exceptions earlier.

Kimberly — can we include a short internal checklist in intake for billing contacts, tax forms, and go-live milestones? I'll own the Order Form draft.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@acme-analytics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-analytics.com>, legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA kickoff / counterparty details

Thanks Kim/Marissa — forwarding our internal priorities and a short redline wishlist (see attached ACME_Redline_Priorities.docx). High level:

1) Limit indemnity to direct damages and cap at 3x fees for pilot phase;
2) Narrow data use language to the pilot's scoped dataset only;
3) We prefer a short DPA exhibit that explicitly lists subprocessors;
4) Billing: we'll use monthly PO-based invoices; PO contact is finance@acme-analytics.com.

Also confirming no export-control restrictions for this engagement; data will stay in us-east.

Attachments: ACME_Redline_Priorities.docx (document)

— Marcus
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-analytics.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@acme-analytics.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA kickoff / counterparty details

Team — thanks for the details and the priorities doc. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Internal intake created (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Acme-MSA).
2) Rishi will perform the initial legal pass on the MSA + Order Form when Acme shares the draft. Expect a redline + issues memo in ~7 business days.
3) Marissa will circulate a pilot Order Form template for PO billing and pilot milestone alignment.

Quick asks for Acme before we start the redline: please upload the current MSA draft (if you have one) or confirm you want Redwood's template, and add preferred signatory names on the counterparty sheet. If you prefer Redwood's template, we'll include the DPA exhibit and a draft data scope to accelerate review.

We'll track items in the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-Q4-47) and move to a shared Doc for resolved redlines.

Thanks — Kim

Onboarding owner: Kimberly Park (Contracts)
Legal reviewer: Rishi Malhotra (cc)
Commercial owner: Marissa Cole (cc)

--
Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
